purpose: Quality gate and routing manifest for using the final_v2 ImageGen concepts as Hunyuan3D image-to-3D references.

coordinate_convention.crop_pixels: [left, top, right, bottom], right and bottom exclusive

strategy_values.hunyuan_solid_mesh: Generate the complete opaque gameplay prop in Hunyuan3D, then clean and retopologize it in Blender.
strategy_values.blender_energy: Do not send the visible effect as a solid object to Hunyuan3D. Use the image only as a shape, palette and material reference for Blender-authored energy meshes and runtime VFX.
strategy_values.hybrid: Send only the explicitly listed opaque support object to Hunyuan3D. Rebuild all energy, floating, transparent and animated elements separately in Blender/runtime.

concept_gate: The intended gameplay object is readable at 256 px.
The primary silhouette is not clipped by the canvas.
The image contains exactly one design and no turntable montage.
The material palette matches Knight violet/black/gold or Mage cobalt/cyan/bronze.
hunyuan_input_gate: Solid-object mask is opaque and separated from all VFX pixels.
Portal holes, ring holes and negative spaces remain transparent.
Detached particles, debris and orbiting pieces are excluded unless generated as a separately named module.
No floor or contact shadow remains in the alpha channel.
At least 6 percent transparent padding surrounds the solid silhouette.
generated_mesh_gate: No accidental membrane fills an intended hole.
No hidden connector bridges independent pieces.
Silhouette matches the concept in front, three-quarter and side QA renders.
Backside is intentionally authored rather than a mirrored or melted projection.
Thin fins, crystal tips and frame segments survive retopology.
Opaque solid mesh contains no particle, glow card, trail or distortion geometry.

audit.silhouette: excellent; one closed shield silhouette with readable negative contours
audit.background: clean dark studio gradient; removal is straightforward
audit.disconnected_parts: none outside the shield body; jewels and studs visually attach to the frame

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Entire opaque shield, including the center crystal bezel and gold hardware.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Animated rune emission, counter ripple, parry sparks, impact flash, point light and distortion.
mask_instructions: Keep the full shield silhouette and attached hardware.
Remove the soft purple aura around the perimeter.
Treat bright rune strips as texture detail, not separate geometry during masking.
asset_quality_gates: Left and right shoulder wings remain symmetrical enough for gameplay readability.
The shield has usable physical thickness in the side render.
Center crystal does not merge into the surrounding frame.

audit.silhouette: strong radial silhouette but composed of many independent modules
audit.disconnected_parts: high; rubble, crystal blades and concentric platform pieces should not be reconstructed as one mesh
audit.hunyuan_readiness: medium after component masking; low if submitted unmasked

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Generate only the central circular stone-and-metal dais as one Hunyuan object. Optionally generate one representative crystal pylon as a second isolated module.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Radial crystal eruption, instanced rubble, expanding rune rings, debris launch, shockwaves, dust, glow and impact distortion.
mask_instructions: Primary Hunyuan mask: include the concentric dais and its attached metal channels only.
Exclude all loose outer rocks, all ten purple crystal blades and all purple glow gaps.
Optional module mask: isolate exactly one upright crystal with its socket on a separate transparent canvas.
Rebuild radial repetition procedurally in Blender instead of asking Hunyuan to infer ten unique disconnected pieces.
asset_quality_gates: Dais remains circular when seen from above.
Top surface stays sufficiently flat for ground placement.
No underside rubble or accidental pedestal is generated.
Crystal eruption count and timing are controlled in Blender, not baked into the solid mesh.

audit.silhouette: excellent wedge-shaped projectile with a clear front and rear
audit.disconnected_parts: low; rear crystal rails appear mounted to the shield assembly

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Entire armored wedge shield and its attached rear crystal rails.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Forward pressure cone, speed ribbons, ground dust, afterimages, collision sparks, armor-break fragments and camera impulse.
mask_instructions: Keep the full hard-surface silhouette.
Remove only the soft violet glow halo and floor shadow.
Do not erase dark gaps between mounted rear rails; preserve them as negative space.
asset_quality_gates: Forward tip remains centered on the local movement axis.
Rear rails do not fuse into a single amorphous block.
The model has a clean attachment socket for the Knight root or shield hand.

audit.silhouette: excellent as a boot concept, but a literal floating boot is not the final dash presentation
audit.hunyuan_readiness: technically high but intentionally not routed to Hunyuan for the final skill

assets.solid_mesh_scope: None for the skill. Reuse the Knight's existing armored leg and boot geometry through character afterimages.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Three fading leg/body afterimages, violet speed streaks, rune footprint decal, foot dust, landing flash and stop-point crystal fragments.
mask_instructions: Do not submit this full boot image to Hunyuan as a standalone skill prop.
Use its purple crystal spike language, segmented armor shapes and palette only as design reference.
If a footprint decal is needed, derive a clean top-down rune silhouette separately in Blender.
asset_quality_gates: No detached boot appears in gameplay.
Afterimages use the actual Knight mesh and remain aligned with the dash trajectory.
The footprint reads as an energy decal rather than physical footwear.

audit.silhouette: excellent crescent arc, but its deliberate broken tail contains many floating shards
audit.hunyuan_readiness: low as one solid model; ideal as a Blender curve, ribbon and particle reference

assets.solid_mesh_scope: None. The Knight sword remains the physical source object.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Weapon-socket-driven crescent ribbon, crystal edge mesh, trailing shards, emissive core, hit flash, sparks, smoke and distortion.
mask_instructions: Do not reconstruct the entire crescent in Hunyuan.
Trace the continuous inner arc as a Blender Bezier curve with bevel and animated taper.
Create two to four reusable crystal shard meshes in Blender and instance them along the decaying tail.
Preserve the empty center; it is negative space, not a portal membrane.
asset_quality_gates: The main ribbon follows the animated sword socket every frame.
Shard spacing increases toward the tail and never forms a static ring.
The damage frame aligns with the brightest impact point.

audit.silhouette: excellent directional projectile with a readable nose, core and tail fins
audit.disconnected_parts: low; bronze rings are held by visible braces

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Blue crystal projectile core, tail fins, bronze containment rings and their braces.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Arc lightning, traveling ribbon, sparks, animated emissive pulse, moving point light, hit burst and crystal fragments.
mask_instructions: Keep the complete projectile assembly and open space inside both bronze rings.
Remove floor shadow and cyan bloom outside the crystal silhouette.
Preserve the clear left-facing projectile direction during canvas centering.
asset_quality_gates: Bronze rings remain circular and do not merge into the blue core.
Local forward axis points from the tail fins toward the long crystal tip.
The core retains enough thickness to read from gameplay distance.

audit.silhouette: strong arena silhouette, with deliberate separate pylons and orrery rings
audit.disconnected_parts: high; seven pylons, multiple rings and a floating crystal are separate modules
audit.hunyuan_readiness: medium after component masking; low as a single unmasked object

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Generate the circular floor altar as one object, one representative crystal pylon as a second object and one bronze orrery-ring segment as a third object.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Procedural pylon placement, rotating orrery assembly, star-map decal, meteor trails, constellation particles, repeated impacts, glow, light and distortion.
mask_instructions: Create three isolated transparent inputs rather than one whole-scene Hunyuan input.
Altar mask: exclude all vertical pylons, floating center crystal, upright orrery and emissive star-map lines.
Pylon mask: isolate one front pylon including its socket; remove every other object.
Orrery mask: isolate a single bronze-and-blue arc module; assemble and animate copies in Blender.
asset_quality_gates: Altar top remains flat and circular.
Seven pylons are instanced from one clean source mesh and can animate independently.
Orrery rings are true circles with a common pivot, not a baked tilted sculpture.
Meteor impacts are runtime effects and never part of the static GLB.

audit.silhouette: excellent solid ring base with one readable ice cluster
audit.background: clean gray studio gradient; slightly lighter than the other concepts but still removable
audit.disconnected_parts: low; most crystals attach to the frame, while the main ice cluster should remain a removable module

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Generate the circular cobalt-and-bronze ring base as one Hunyuan object and the large ice cluster as a separate Hunyuan object.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Radial ice-growth animation, expanding frost wave, rune emission, snow particles, fog, refraction, shatter pieces and cold point lights.
mask_instructions: Base mask: remove the entire large ice cluster and all glow beneath the ring while preserving the central hole as transparent.
Ice mask: isolate only the large left cluster on a separate transparent square canvas.
Do not let the central opening become a solid disk.
Treat cyan strips and small inset gems as material detail.
asset_quality_gates: Ring is circular from top view and has a consistent underside.
Central hole remains open in the mesh.
Ice cluster has a flat, hidden attachment base for animated growth.
Runtime ice shards use instanced variants rather than duplicating a high-poly cluster.

audit.silhouette: strong device silhouette but intentionally includes floating rocks and a suspended core
audit.disconnected_parts: high; orbit rocks, broken rings and central crystal assembly are independent
audit.hunyuan_readiness: medium after component masking; low if submitted unmasked

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Generate the grounded stone pedestal as one object, a clean bronze ring segment as a second object and one representative dark rock as a third object.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Assemble rotating rings, levitate and instance rocks, build the central energy core, spiral particle flow, attraction trails, distortion, collapse flash and shockwave.
mask_instructions: Pedestal mask: include only the grounded circular stone-and-bronze base.
Ring mask: isolate one complete representative arc without lightning or adjacent rocks.
Rock mask: isolate one dark faceted rock; generate variety through Blender transforms and two low-cost sculpt variants.
Exclude all purple tendrils, cyan glow, suspended center cluster and every other floating component.
asset_quality_gates: Pedestal sits flat on the ground without a generated hidden cone.
All orbiting parts have explicit Blender pivots and never depend on baked vertex animation.
The center remains an animated energy volume, not an opaque Hunyuan blob.
Ring modules can form true concentric circles without visible seams at gameplay distance.

audit.silhouette: excellent portal frame, but the bright interior and detached orbit arcs must not enter the solid mask
audit.disconnected_parts: medium-high; orbit arcs are intentionally detached from the main stone frame
audit.hunyuan_readiness: high for the masked stone frame; low for the unmasked full image

assets.solid_mesh_scope: Generate only the cobalt stone portal frame, its grounded base and hardware physically attached to that frame. Generate one bronze orbit segment separately if needed.
assets.blender_vfx_scope: Portal membrane, vortex depth layers, orbiting rune segments, entry and exit portals, body dissolve particles, connecting streak, glow, distortion and teleport flashes.
mask_instructions: Cut the entire cyan-violet portal interior to transparent before Hunyuan generation.
Preserve the oval hole as true negative space.
Exclude all detached bronze orbit segments from the main frame mask.
Remove outer bloom and floor shadow while keeping attached blue stone and inset crystal hardware.
asset_quality_gates: Portal opening is a real hole with a clean inner rim.
Base is flat, stable and wide enough to avoid visual floating.
Detached orbit segments share one clean pivot around the portal center.
The animated vortex is rendered separately and never baked into the opaque frame texture.

audit_summary.decision: All ten final_v2 ImageGen concepts pass the visual concept gate. None needs regeneration. Seven images require masking or component extraction before Hunyuan3D; two energy-only concepts must bypass Hunyuan and be authored as animated Blender/runtime VFX.
